nodes.label: PLA2G4C
props: Cytosolic lysophospholipase; Cytosolic lysophospholipid O-acyltransferase; Phospholipase A2 group IVC

Calcium-independent phospholipase, lysophospholipase and O-acyltransferase involved in phospholipid remodeling with implications in endoplasmic reticulum membrane homeostasis and lipid droplet biogenesis. Preferentially hydrolyzes the ester bond of the fatty acyl group attached at the sn-2 position of phospholipids with choline and ethanolamine head groups, producing lysophospholipids that are used in deacylation-reacylation cycles.
Cell membrane, Endoplasmic reticulum membrane, Mitochondrion membrane, Lipid droplet

nodes.label: PLA2G4A
props: Has primarily calcium-dependent phospholipase and lysophospholipase activities, with a major role in membrane lipid remodeling and biosynthesis of lipid mediators of the inflammatory response. Plays an important role in embryo implantation and parturition through its ability to trigger prostanoid production.
Cytoplasm, Golgi apparatus membrane, Nucleus envelope
